instructions_to_main_agent: Use expo-blur (BlurView) for the Home Screen dock, dating app text overlays, and quotes widget to give it a premium 'Apple for fairies' Glassmorphism feel.
Use expo-linear-gradient for app icons and gradient backgrounds (e.g. Spotify background).
Use @expo/vector-icons (Ionicons or MaterialCommunityIcons) for all icons (music, heart, flame, etc). Do not use standard text emojis.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, app icons) have a data-testid attribute for testing purposes.
On the Home Screen, ensure the background image (home_wallpaper) is set to 'absolute' fill, and apps/widgets render on top of it.
For the Dating App, the image (puck_avatar) should take up the majority of the screen inside a rounded card, with a BlurView overlay at the bottom for his name, age, and bio.
Ensure smooth mock navigation. Use conditional rendering or a simple state switcher to swap between Home, Spotify, and Dating screens to simulate opening/closing apps.
